network_status.network: Progetto di ricostruzione del ponte sul Tanaro a Monchiero
network_status.summary_it: La fonte provinciale documenta cedimenti fondazionali gia rilevati in aprile, portate elevate durante maggio e giugno e il collasso della pila il 27 giugno 2010. Non identifica un singolo colmo evento-specifico ne pubblica un valore: il degrado progressivo resta distinto dall'idrometria.
network_status.summary_en: The provincial source documents foundation settlement already observed in April, high flows during May and June and pier collapse on 27 June 2010. It identifies no single event-specific peak and publishes no value, so progressive degradation remains distinct from hydrometry.

provenance.method: Manual extraction encoded in the ARCUS event-report curation registry

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
